interpretation.promotion_rule: For paired candidate-minus-incumbent scores, promote only when mean_delta + threshold < 0.
interpretation.scope: These thresholds estimate random-MLP suite uncertainty. They do not estimate repeated-run randomness on one fixed MLP.
